landing.hero_title: Figure out your future in real estate.
landing.hero_subtitle: Twenty minutes of honest questions. Your investor identity, the strategies that fit it, and a plan for the next 72 hours.
landing.thesis: A conference hands you thirty strategies. InvestorOS tells you which one is yours.
landing.example_insight: Strong skills and solid capital; the network is what's holding back door four.
landing.paths_title: Wherever you are, there's a path.
landing.paths_subtitle: The same twenty minutes; the answer depends on where you're starting from.
landing.path.curious.label: Curious, zero doors
landing.path.curious.title: Find out what kind of investor you'd be
landing.path.curious.description: Your archetype, an honest readiness score, and the one first move that fits your money, time and risk instead of somebody else's.
landing.path.first_doors.label: First doors, 1 to 3
landing.path.first_doors.title: See what's actually blocking door four
landing.path.first_doors.description: Capital, time, skills or network: the readiness radar shows which one it is, and the action plan and 72-hour micro-plan go straight at it.
landing.path.scaling.label: Scaling, 4 and up
landing.path.scaling.title: Growth paths built from your own numbers
landing.path.scaling.description: Portfolio and capital paths with milestones and a scaling vision for years one, three, five and ten. Two more paths are coming; this part is beta.
landing.step.audits.title: Answer five short audits
landing.step.audits.description: Finances, time, skills, risk and goals. Save and come back any time; sensitive answers are encrypted.
landing.step.identity.title: Get your identity card
landing.step.identity.description: An archetype, a readiness score and a five-axis radar, with a headline on what's holding you back.
landing.step.strategy.title: Pick a strategy, get a plan
landing.step.strategy.description: Three strategies ranked by fit. Activate one for an action plan, a roadmap with dates and a 72-hour micro-plan.
landing.step.growth.title: Grow along your paths
landing.step.growth.description: Growth paths unlock as you complete tasks, and a what-if simulator shows how changing one thing changes your identity.
landing.built_title: Built by an investor, after a conference
landing.built_body: I came home from BPCON last year with a notebook full of strategies and no way to tell which one fit my money, my time and my life. So I built the tool I wanted that night: one that starts from who you are, not from the deal of the week. I own a single-family rental in Cleveland and I'm working toward a 2 to 10 unit multifamily; the app is how I'm planning it.
landing.faq.free.a: Yes, for everyone in the beta. If there's ever a paid version, beta users hear about it first and nothing you built goes away.
landing.faq.time.a: About twenty minutes for the five audits, then a minute or so while your identity is generated. You can stop and come back; progress is saved.
landing.faq.data.a: Income, assets, debts, credit range and tax rate are encrypted at rest. Nothing is sold or shared for ads, and you can have everything erased by asking. Approximate numbers work fine.
landing.faq.advice.a: No. Everything is generated from your own answers to help you think and plan. Check decisions with a licensed professional.
landing.faq.beta.a: Two of the four growth paths say Coming Soon, and you'll hit rough edges. There's a feedback link on every page; what you tell us is what gets built next.
landing.disclaimer: InvestorOS is a planning tool, not financial, legal or tax advice.
